description: A white smartphone lies on a green cloth with a white charging cable plugged into it in front of both hands. The right hand reaches to the phone, grips it near the top, and lifts it slightly while the left hand moves in to grasp the cable plug; the left hand pulls the plug straight out of the phone, making the cable a left-hand object and the phone a right-hand object, then both are set back down separately on the cloth.
